subject: biology-2
question: According to the **RNA world hypothesis**, RNA, not DNA or protein, was the first molecule of heredity and catalysis. Which property makes RNA the best candidate for this early role?

options.text: RNA is more stable than DNA, so it could survive the harsh conditions of early Earth.
RNA is the only molecule found in every living cell on Earth.
RNA cannot catalyze reactions, so it served only as a storage molecule.
RNA can both store genetic information and catalyze chemical reactions.

explanation: RNA is unique in combining heredity and catalysis: it stores genetic information like DNA and, as a ribozyme, speeds up reactions like a protein enzyme. That dual role lets a single molecule carry both the blueprint and the machinery, so RNA could manage early life before DNA and proteins existed. A is backward, since RNA is less stable than DNA; B is false, since many molecules are found in all cells; and C contradicts the discovery of catalytic ribozymes.
